notes.title: Pre-order the Jusant Deluxe box set!
notes.content:
We are so happy to be partnering with [url=https://www.pixnlove.com/]Pixnlove[/url] to be able to bring you exclusive Jusant merch, including the physical PS5 game (a Pix’n love exclusive version with a reversible cover, limited to 1000 copies), as well as a making-of artbook and the award-winning original soundtrack on dual vinyl, signed by composer Guillaume Ferran. You can pre-order the physical game and the artbook both individually, or together with the vinyl in a beautiful deluxe box from today! 

[url=https://bit.ly/Jusant_Physical_Edition]You can pre-order here.[/url]
[url=https://bit.ly/Jusant_Edition_Physique]And here for French stores.[/url]

This collaboration really takes our game to the next level and offers fans a gorgeous and tangible piece of the adventure. Included in the limited edition deluxe box set (of which there are 300) are:  

[list]
[*] Physical PS5 game with a Pixnlove exclusive reversible cover 
[*] 4 lithographs 
[*] 300-page hardback making-of artbook (collector’s edition cover) in a deluxe sleeve 
[*] Original soundtrack in dual vinyl, signed by Guillaume Ferran and with exclusively colored double vinyl 
[*] Numbered certificate of authenticity 
[/list]

... all in a beautiful box! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237183/6408c1f1d54ca64f707ca70e98406ac868134309.png[/img]

The making-of art book, written by Marine Macq, comes in standard edition and collector’s edition (which is in the deluxe box set) versions, which have different covers. The book contains exclusive behind-the-scenes artwork, insights, and commentary from the team.  

Thanks to pixnlove once again and to all of you for supporting Jusant!

notes.title: Jusant patch 1.06
notes.content:
[b]Hello climbers! Here are a few quick fixes we’ve made to ensure smoother sailing in Jusant. [/b]

[h2]Tech [/h2]
[list]
[*] DLSS 3 added 
[*] VSync is now correctly disabled when activating Reflex or FrameGeneration 
[*] Qualities not supported by hardware will be removed from the list 
[*] DLAA quality has been added. 
[/list]

[h2]Other fixes [/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed Out of Memory crash when wind particles accumulate 
[*] Fixed line breaks in letters (for French language) 
[*] Added missing walking SFX for lizard 
[*] Achievements ‘Acrobat’, ‘Fresh Air’ and ‘Restored Connection’ should now be handled properly with reload and unlocked properly 
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented players to “Continue” their save, after completing and starting a new game 
[*] Updated credits. 
[/list]

notes.title: Jusant patch 1.04 - The Accessibility Update
notes.content:
Hello climbers! Before we get into the patch notes, we wanted to give a big thank you to all players who have taken the time to leave feedback or a review of Jusant.  

We’ve titled this patch The Accessibility Update, as many new accessibility features have been added as well as bugfixes (ultrawide players, rejoice!) and quality of life changes of course. We’re pleased to welcome even more players to the tower with this update.  

 

[h2]Accessibility additions: [/h2]

Simplified Climbing Mode (instead of triggers, only the joysticks are used) 

Alternate Rappel Mode and tutorials 

Simplified Interactions Mode 

Jump Assistance 

No Stamina Mode (stamina mechanic can be deactivated) 

Color Blindness options and intensity sliders (Deuteranopia, Protanopia, Tritanopia) 

 

[h2]Animation [/h2]

• Improved shaky movements performed by the character during climbing and  

when the rope is at maximum 

• Improved character’s hand location on grips 

• Improved multiple broken animations when jumping over several assets 

• Fixed grass animation clipping through assets in chapter 5 

• Fixed Ballast clipping through character’s head during climbing and gripping  

animations 

• Fixed animations on peebles 

• Fixed the possibility to bypass the rope wind tutorial 

• Fixed a possibility to get stuck at the top of a ladder 

• Corrected character’s hands location on the gear in chapter 4 

• Improved interactions with the relays 

• Fixed misplaced foot during game ending cutscene 

• Fixed wallrun animation missing when rope is at its maximum 

• Improved out of bounds falling issues 

• Fixed jump animation after exiting seashell cutscene 

• Improved wind’s interaction with character’s hair and poncho 

 

[h2]Environment [/h2]

• Fixed several missing collisions in environment 

• Fixed invisible collisions in several parts of the environment 

 

[h2]Gameplay Programming [/h2]

• Bluetooth now recognized for Dualshock 4 and Dualsense  

• Collectibles now saved when starting a new game 

• Fixed the missing peebles in biome 2 in a specific area  

• Fixed the partly cut-off screen loading symbol on lower resolutions 

• Fixed control option to invert X and Y camera axis when using mousepad 

• Fixed remapping issues 

• Language can now be changed from system’s default language 

• Resetting default language to OS language is fixed for FR, IT, DE, PL, JP, KR, RU, ZH-Hans 

• Improved ziplines and related rope 

• Improved performance drops and FPS 

• Fixed gamma submenu “back button” navigation  

• Cinematics and gameplay transitions in ultrawide won't stretch the image for one frame  

anymore 

• Ultrawide won't crop and zoom image in 21:9 

 

[h2]Lighting [/h2]

• Improvement on lighting at the end of biome 2 observatory cinematic 

 

[h2]Camera [/h2]

• Fixed several incorrect camera zooms 

• Improved camera clipping through walls and character 

• Fixed incorrect camera location when reloading biome 3 checkpoint 

 

[h2]UI [/h2]

• Fixed UI overlaps issues 

• Fixed prompts that used to hide climbing path 

 

[h2]Tech and Performance [/h2]

• Added auto HDR settings on XSS & XSX 

• Added motion blur scale settings on all platforms 

• Added DLSS3 settings 

• Fixed physics optimisation on low specs 

• Fixed autodetection of graphics settings 

 

[h2]Audio [/h2]

• Fixed elevator SFX 

• Fixed footsteps material 

 

[h2]Design [/h2]

• Fixed character stuck in several parts of environment 

• Fixed UI tutorials remaining on screen 

• Fixed inconsistencies between credits from main menu and game ending 

• Fixed grappling hook interaction in chapter 3 

• Fixed the manual stamina spamming that was leading to unlocking the Fresh air achievement 

• No more delay on Ballast loading after a continue  

• Fixed various visible macros in texts 

• Fixed lizard clipping through chapter 4 - mountain 

• Fixed sparkles issues 

• Fixed floating seashell.

notes.title: Jusant patch 1.02.1431188 (Day One)
notes.content:
Jusant is finally out, and we’ve put together a day one patch to introduce some improvements for smoother sailing.  

[h1]ANIMATION[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improvements on the jump mechanic feedback
[*] Improvements on zipline animations to add idle movement
[*] Several improvements on gameplay animations
[*] Retakes on cutscenes animations to better reflect creative intentions. 
[/list]

[h1]ENVIRONMENT[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved environments in all cutscenes
[*] Clouds reworked in specific cutscenes 
[*] Various environments were reworked on all biomes. 
[/list]

[h1]LIGHTING[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved lighting across the game
[*] Improved lighting on all cutscenes 
[*] Upped the lighting in darker areas to help player navigation 
[*] Transition between first and second biome’s lighting was reworked to fix performance and visual issues.
[/list] 

[h1]VFX[/h1]
[list]
[*] VFX overhaul on most cutscenes to reflect creative intentions 
[*] Revamped echo effect on some observatory cutscenes. 
[/list]

[h1]AUDIO[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved audio on all cutscenes
[*] Improved audio on all moods
[*] Improved audio on footsteps
[*] Improved audio on gameplay features (vines, pebbles).
[/list]

[h1]UI[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved stamina gauge visuals
[*] Added chapters menu
[*] Polished all menus.
[/list]

[h1]FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added data tracking implementation
[*] Added HDR Support
[*] Added additional accessibility settings. 
[/list]

[h1]DESIGN[/h1]
[list]
[*] Additional fauna integration
[*] General debug and cleaning on all biomes
[*] Tweaks on Tutorial scripting, specific gameplay cameras and climbing paths in general
[*] Forced feedback addition on cutscenes.
[/list]

[h1]KNOWN ISSUES (to be fixed with an incoming patch)[/h1]
[list]
[*] For PC players using mouse & keyboard:
[/list] In version 1.02.1431188, it is possible to rebind the input meant to go back to the game after reading any letter. But even if players change that key, they still need to use the default one (Backspace) to be able to move on. If no input works properly, players must use right-click on a mouse.

[list]
[*] For PC players with ultrawide monitors:
[/list] Currently on 21:9 screens, the original image becomes cropped. We’re working on a fix for this that’ll come at the end of November, but until then you can fix it locally by following these instructions: 
- Follow this path on your computer: %localappdata%/ASC/Saved/Config/Windows/ 
- Open the file Engine.ini (you can use Notepad, for instance) 
- Add the following directly in the file: 

[/script/asc.asclocalplayer] 
MaxAspectRatio=1.7777777777777 

[list]
[*] Graphics (PC): 
[/list] On the first launch of Jusant, the game may automatically recognize your graphics settings to be lower than they actually are. While we work on a fix, you can manually set your graphics a level higher and see how you go.

notes.title: Everything you need to know about Jusant – an FAQ
notes.content:
[h1]Do I need a controller to play? [/h1]

Jusant is playable with mouse and keyboard but the controls were designed with controllers in mind, and we strongly recommend using a controller for the best experience. 

 

[h1]I played the demo. Does my progress carry over? [/h1]

No, your progress will reset. 

 

[h1]How do I get the best graphics on PC?  [/h1]

On the first launch of Jusant, the game may automatically recognize your graphics settings to be lower than they actually are. While we work on a fix, you can manually set your graphics a level higher and see how you go. 

 

[h1]How do I get ultrawide support to work on PC? [/h1]

Currently on 21:9 screens, the original image becomes cropped. We’re working on a fix for this that’ll come at the end of November, but until then you can fix it locally by following these instructions: 

- Follow this path on your computer: %localappdata%/ASC/Saved/Config/Windows/ 

- Open the file Engine.ini (you can use Notepad, for instance) 

- Add the following directly in the file: 

[/script/asc.asclocalplayer] 

MaxAspectRatio=1.7777777777777 

 

[h1]Does the game have accessibility features?  [/h1]

There are some accessibility settings in Jusant, like font and camera options.  

In a future patch releasing at the end of November, we will implement the following features: 

[list][*] No Stamina [/list] Allows players to play the game without the stamina mechanic 


[list][*] Simplified Climbing Mode [/list] - Enables climbing and moving on the wall solely by using the stick
- Eliminates the need to hold down buttons for the piton or rope actions 


[list][*] Jump Assistance [/list] Automatically grabs holds around the character when active 


[list][*] Simplified Interactions[/list] Eliminates the need to hold down buttons for cranks and altars 


[list][*] Rappel Modification[/list] Switches to a rappel mode where the left stick controls ascent and descent 


[list][*] Colorblind Mode [/list] Offers different color filters (3) to enhance color rendering for individuals with difficulty perceiving certain colors. 

 

[h1]What should I do if I run into a bug?  [/h1]

You can report the bug on our Help Center here: https://support.dont-nod.com/hc/en-gb/requests/new  

 

[h1]Do I need to know how to climb to play? [/h1] 

Nope! You can hop right in and immediately start getting to grips with the climbing tools. 

 

[h1]Is the soundtrack available to buy anywhere?  [/h1]

Yes! You can buy the soundtrack on its own on Steam or get it with the game in a bundle here: https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/35836/Jusant_Soundtrack_edition/    

Or you can buy it on other digital platforms here: https://idol-io.ffm.to/jusantost  

 

[h1]What are the recommended PC specs to play Jusant?  [/h1]

Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system 

OS: Windows 10 

Processor: Core i7-6700 

Memory: 16 GB RAM 

Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080, or AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT 

Storage: 20 GB available space 

 

[h1]What languages is the game in?  [/h1]

Jusant is playable in English, French, Italian, German, Spanish (Spain), Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, and Simplified Chinese.
